title: 22nd Sitting of Second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/22/2/2026).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 16/2/2026 to 18/2/2026).

Question from Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem to the Minister of Homeland Security, Labour and Technology, Ali Ihusaan: on what legal basis did senior government officials disclose, at a 23 April press conference, private messages between a student who died and the police Victim Support Service, and is publishing such sensitive personal data ministry policy whenever police negligence is alleged?

Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Homeland Security, Labour and Technology, Ali Ihusaan: land has been handed over for the promised police station in B. Kamadhoo, so why has no practical work started and when will it begin and finish?

From the Speaker's desk: the President's request, under Articles 115(f)(1) and 93(a) of the Constitution, for Parliament's approval for the Maldives to sign and ratify the Charter of the Multinational Maritime Defence Coalition is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
First reading of the bill to amend the National Payment System Act (Law No. 8/2021), submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhudhoo MP Mohamed Shahid.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the National Payment System Act (Law No. 8/2021), submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhudhoo MP Mohamed Shahid.

Unfinished business: continued debate on the resolution by Hulhumale South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed calling on the government to immediately halt the sale of permanent residence permits to foreigners under the "Maldives Pearl Residence Programme" and disclose all related agreements to Parliament.
Public Accounts Committee report on the special audit of Fenaka Corporation Limited's procurement of goods and services and its financial position and accounting.
Public Accounts Committee report on the resolution calling for faster investigation and action on corrupt practices identified in the Auditor General's special audit of Fenaka Corporation Limited.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the home minister, sent a maritime defence charter to committee, introduced a National Payment System Act amendment, and took up two Fenaka audit reports.
